title: Prefill: indexer logits + exact top-k
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: baseline MEASURED in-step (INFRA NVFP4 prefill baseline 17:48: idx_score 9.86 + DSA.topk 4.77 + idx quant/insert 0.70 over 6 DSA layers); current = stock until the new path is wired in-step; new-path progress is 1-GPU microbench at the deployed per-GPU shape (3 x 5461 rows at 78360 keys) per DSA layer
gap_analysis: Target 9.28 ms over 6 DSA layers = 1.55 ms/layer for score + select + quant/insert (stock in-step 2.55 ms/layer). SOL design (hardware limit at stock precision): one persistent tcgen05 score kernel (keys on M=128, 8 tokens x 32 heads on N=256, 2x-K MXF4 MMA, accumulators in exclusive TMEM, epilogue = stock packed-BF16 relu/convert + BF16x2 FMA chains, logits written once as BF16) + one bandwidth-bound exact select (one streaming read of the logits, vector-maxima histogram, hot-vector gather, exact two-digit radix over candidates). Bound resource of the score: the packed-BF16 FMA pipe in the epilogue (MEASURED probe on VR200: BF16x2 FMA issues at half the FP32 FMA instruction rate; convert co-issues on another pipe) -> 32 epilogue instructions per (token, key) at stock precision -> ~0.68 ms/layer floor; MMA + key stream measured 0.54 ms/layer and runs under it. Select floor: one read of 2.5 GB logits/layer (~0.2 ms). Projected SOL ~0.9 (score) + 0.25 (select) + 0.12 (quant/insert) = ~1.27 ms/layer = 7.6 ms vs target 9.28. MODEL NOTE: the model prices idx_score as an FP32-SIMT epilogue (1.206 ms/layer); stock math is packed BF16 whose binding pipe gives ~0.68 ms/layer, so the model over-prices the score epilogue by ~1.8x while its total (1.41 ms/layer) remains a valid target.
inefficiencies: MEASURED (fixed in e2): previous score epilogue spilled (STACK 64 at the 96-register cap) and only half the epilogue warps read each tile -> 2.28 ms; now every warp reads every tile, weights in registers, no spills: 1.62 ms

MEASURED: e2 score epilogue lockstep stalls: all 16 warps wait on the same accumulator stage and TMEM load latency is exposed per chunk (clock stamps: ~700 clk per tile per warp vs ~420 issue demand) -> e3 adds a two-buffer TMEM load pipeline
MEASURED: old PrefillSelect 0.96 ms/layer: one 1024-thread CTA per row, latency-bound serial phases -> replaced by persistent 4-row-group select (e3, measuring)
MODEL ERROR: idx_score epilogue priced as FP32 SIMT; stock math is packed BF16 (binding pipe measured)
rubin_features: 2x-K block-scaled MMA (mxf4 K128) via sm_107a descriptors
576-column exclusive TMEM (2 accumulator stages + scale factors)
oversized shared memory for 4 concurrent per-row select groups
plan: Score: 4-chunk two-buffer TMEM pipeline (e3), then trim per-tile overhead (uniform causal-edge test, fewer address ops); target <= 0.95 ms/layer microbench
Select: persistent 4 row groups x 256 threads per CTA, one streaming read + hot-vector gather + exact radix over candidates, exact overflow path; target <= 0.3 ms/layer

Wire into the prefill indexer (specialized_prefill entry + minimal hook in vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/dsa.py: one score+select per layer over all prefill rows, keys gathered 128-aligned per request), unit test vs stock (bitwise logits, exact top-k), step A/B with step_p.sh -q nvfp4 on wzhao/k31ws-int
Then fuse index q quant + key insert (0.70 vs 0.08 ms) if still above target
